## Looking for
- Tech Lead / Team Lead role in a product team of 3–8 engineers, keeping 30–50% hands-on engineering. Fintech and payments, e-commerce and marketplaces, B2B platforms, high-load media. Remote or hybrid, Moscow.

- Lamoda Tech (2022-2024) — Senior PHP Developer: Chestny Znak / CRPT labeling compliance on time, PHP 7.4→8.1 migration, ~30% faster CI/CD delivery
- Rambler&Co · Advertising Platform (2021-2022) — Senior PHP Developer: Go bidding and auction service, advertiser reporting, REST APIs on Kafka
- MTS Fintech (2020-2021) — Team Lead (PHP): team of 5 engineers (hiring, 1:1s, Scrum), centralized config and feature-flag service from scratch (DDD), RBAC, 85% test coverage
- Webguru.pro (2017-2020) — CTO / Co-founder (own studio, part-time): 50+ projects (AB InBev, MegaFon, Alliance Retail Group), AliceBot.pro SaaS, team of up to 8
- ETP Gazprombank (2016-2020) — Senior PHP Developer: participant billing microservice (cards, acquiring, SBP), EIS integration under 44-FZ/223-FZ, PHP 5.6→7
- Avito (2016) — PHP Developer: billing microservice, MIR card integration
- Mamba/Tourbar (2015-2016) — PHP Developer: REST API for mobile apps, Elasticsearch search over millions of profiles
- Sutochno.ru (2011-2015) — Senior PHP Developer: auction-based top listings, unified payments, accounting automation
